data.title: Find The Farm Words
data.description: Look closely at the pictures and words on each page.

books.author: Sam Hill
books.coverImagePrompt: A bright red barn with a green tractor parked in front under a sunny blue sky, digital children book illustration style.
books.coverImageAlt: A cheerful red barn sits by a green tractor on a sunny day.

pages.heading: Big Red Barn
paragraphs: The tall red barn keeps the animals safe from rain.
A fluffy sheep walks by the wide door.
pages.imagePrompt: A red barn with a fluffy white sheep standing near the open door, digital children book illustration style.
pages.imageAlt: A fluffy sheep stands near the open door of a red barn.
pages.caption: Barn And Sheep

focusWords.definition: A large farm building used to store crops or house animals.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the large red building on the left.

focusWords.definition: A woolly farm animal that eats grass.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the fluffy white animal standing near the door.

pages.heading: Green Tractor
paragraphs: The loud green tractor pulls a heavy cart.
Soft hay piles up in the back.
pages.imagePrompt: A green tractor pulling a cart full of yellow hay in a green field, digital children book illustration style.
pages.imageAlt: A green tractor pulls a cart filled with hay.
pages.caption: Tractor And Hay

focusWords.definition: A strong machine used on a farm to pull heavy loads.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the big green machine in the middle.

focusWords.definition: Cut and dried grass used to feed farm animals.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the yellow pile in the cart.

pages.heading: Busy Pond
paragraphs: A yellow duck swims in the blue pond.
Soft mud sits near the edge.
pages.imagePrompt: A yellow duck swimming in a blue pond with brown mud on the bank, digital children book illustration style.
pages.imageAlt: A yellow duck swims in a blue pond.
pages.caption: Duck And Pond

focusWords.definition: A water bird with webbed feet and a short bill.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the yellow bird swimming in the water.

focusWords.definition: Wet dirt found near water on a farm.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the dark wet dirt by the water edge.

challenges.prompt: Listen to the sentence. Then say the glowing underlined word.
challenges.hint: Look at the large red building on the left.
challenges.readTail: keeps the animals safe from rain.
